How to keep schemas in Git and move them between environments is in [Schema files](/schema-files).

```text
Keep collection schemas in a JSON file: export, compare, apply

Usage: tachyon schema [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  export  Write every collection's schema as JSON
  diff    Show what applying a schema file would change, without changing anything
  apply   Apply a schema file. Changes that delete or retype data need --yes
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>  Config file. Every setting can also come from a TACHYON_* environment variable [default: tachyon.toml]
  -h, --help             Print help
```
